q1.explanationZh: 第一段说很多人认为有些语言比别的语言更难学，harder to learn than others。

evidence.quote: Many people think that some languages are harder to learn than others.

q2.explanationZh: 第一段举例：欧洲人学日语比学英语更难。

evidence.quote: A European, for example, may find it more difficult to learn Japanese than English.

q3.explanationZh: 第二段说语言被放进一棵“树”里，这个树状模型就是 language tree。

evidence.quote: The languages have been put into a “tree”.

q4.explanationZh: 第二段给出定义：两种语言之间的距离叫语言距离。

evidence.quote: The distance between two languages is called their

q5.explanationZh: 法语和印地语在不同亚群，所以法语要拿来和印地语比；按官方答案顺序，这里填 Hindi。

evidence.quote: This means French is “closer” to Spanish than to Hindi.

q6.explanationZh: 法语和西班牙语在同一亚群，所以另一边是 Spanish。

evidence.quote: This means French is “closer” to Spanish than to Hindi.

q7.explanationZh: 法语离印地语更远，所以法国人学印地语比学西班牙语更难，填比较级 harder 或 more difficult。

evidence.quote: most French speakers will find it easier to learn Spanish than to learn Hindi

q8.explanationZh: 第五段说这种“距离”的影响（effect）是相互的。

q9.explanationZh: be faced with 意为“面对”，与前面的 face 同义；will be 后接过去分词 faced with。

evidence.quote: will face a certain level of difficulty when learning English

q9.tipsZh: be faced with 面临，面对

q10.explanationZh: 第五段说中国人学英语会遇到一定程度（a certain level）的困难，英语使用者学中文也是类似程度。

evidence.quote: will face a certain level of difficulty when learning English
